PreCommit.command: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm container:validate
PreCommit.description: Lint, test, and validate container shape before every commit

PostToolUse.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=process.env.CLAUDE_FILE_PATH;if(!p)process.exit(0);const t=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!/^syllabus_source:/m.test(t)){console.warn('[paideia] WARN: '+p+' is under a SEAB-2027 path but has no `syllabus_source:` frontmatter line. v0 warn-only — will become a hard block once the path tree exists.');}"
PostToolUse.description: Warn (v0) when SEAB-2027 content lacks `syllabus_source:` frontmatter. Aspirational — paths may not yet exist. Will harden to a block in v1.
